step1_analysis.description: A continuous-time pseudo-differential operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) utilizing low-voltage current mirrors and a cross-coupled PMOS pair for negative resistance gain enhancement. It is designed for low-voltage continuous-time filters.

paper_reference.title: Design of Low-Voltage CMOS Continuous-Time Filter with On-Chip Automatic Tuning

sky130_expected.calculation: Cross-coupled PMOS provides negative resistance to boost output impedance. Gain = gm * Rout. With negative resistance, Rout can be very high.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to match paper's 60 dB, though extraction errors in the netlist (XM1 connections) may cause it to saturate and yield <0 dB in raw simulation.

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 main branches (2 input, 2 output) each carrying ~100uA. Total current ~400uA. Power = 1.8V * 400uA = 0.72 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported power range, scaled slightly for 1.8V VDD.

Unity_Gain_Frequency.description: Frequency where open-loop gain drops to 0 dB

sky130_expected.calculation: UGB = gm / (2 * pi * Cload). gm ~ 1mA/V, Cload = 1pF -> UGB ~ 150 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: OTA UGB must be at least 50x higher than the filter cutoff frequency to maintain linearity and phase accuracy.

Input_Offset_Voltage.description: Differential input voltage required to bring differential output to 0V

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideally 0V for symmetric layout. Due to netlist extraction error on XM1, offset will be massive.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Included to characterize the asymmetry caused by the extraction error.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for Pseudo-Differential OTA measuring AC gain, UGB, phase margin, DC offset, and power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pseudo-Differential OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

XM1 GND N5 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 VDD N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 VDD N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N4 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N4 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N1 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9

VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5

C1 N1 0 1p
C2 N4 0 1p

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 50 1 1G
  let out_diff = v(N4) - v(N1)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(out_diff))
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(out_diff)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugb when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

  dc VLABEL_NET_2 0 1.8 0.01
  let out_diff_dc = v(N4) - v(N1)
  meas dc offset_voltage when out_diff_dc=0
  meas dc max_out max out_diff_dc
  meas dc min_out min out_diff_dc

  tran 1n 1u
  meas tran v_max max v(N4)
  meas tran v_min min v(N4)
  quit
.endc
